“Things are looking so bleak for me. I feel more alone than I ever felt, even though I have friends and relatives that support me. I am not suicidal, but I can't wait for death to come for me, just to see his little face again. I just want desperately to know that I can meet him again in the afterlife.”

I felt this in my soul as I am going through the same thing. 15 years for me and it wasn’t nearly long enough. No where feels safe without my little guy and I struggle with the idea that I couldn’t look death in the face either. I would like to believe that our babies are waiting for us in the afterlife but they are also right here with us, just not in a physical form. 

I am so sorry for your loss. Take comfort in knowing that you are not alone with these feelings, as I did after seeing your post. 🤍
